tooltip.kunjinkao.kun_jin_kao.line_1: Forged from a shard lost in the ancient flood of code,
tooltip.kunjinkao.kun_jin_kao.line_2: its blade has no edge, yet is carved with flowing garbled runes.
tooltip.kunjinkao.kun_jin_kao.line_3: This sword carries two mutually exclusive laws at once:
tooltip.kunjinkao.kun_jin_kao.line_4: Overwrite - forcibly rewrite the target's low-level attributes in the "world system".
tooltip.kunjinkao.kun_jin_kao.line_6: are all overwritten with the values the sword master defines the moment the blade touches.
tooltip.kunjinkao.kun_jin_kao.line_7: Unset - one extra strike that harms no body, only erases the target's "definition".
tooltip.kunjinkao.kun_jin_kao.line_8: You are not weakened, sealed, or defeated;
tooltip.kunjinkao.kun_jin_kao.line_9: you simply become an "undefined entry" the system cannot recognize,
tooltip.kunjinkao.kun_jin_kao.line_10: and unable to process you, the system ignores, forgets, and zeroes you out.
tooltip.kunjinkao.kun_jin_kao.line_11: The enemy's discipline, gear and buffs, before Overwrite,
tooltip.kunjinkao.kun_jin_kao.line_12: are just a line of text that Ctrl+C can replace;
tooltip.kunjinkao.kun_jin_kao.line_13: the trump card the enemy prides itself on loses even the right to be remembered after Unset.
tooltip.kunjinkao.kun_jin_kao.line_14: Your opponent is not fighting a swordsman,
tooltip.kunjinkao.kun_jin_kao.line_15: but a madman holding permission to edit the world's source code.

screen.kunjinkao.qol.title: Function Console
screen.kunjinkao.qol.cosmetic_title.desc: Floats a mojibake nameplate above your own name tag (§d❓❓ §f + your name), visible to every player. It is a badge of admin identity, so only password-verified admins can turn it on.
screen.kunjinkao.qol.cosmetic_orbit.desc: Three swords hover behind you, visible to every player (in first person they sit behind the camera, so you will not see them). When a player attacks you, one of them flies to their head and stabs downward: 1 point every 10 ticks for 5 seconds, always leaving them 1 heart.
screen.kunjinkao.qol.cosmetic_aura.desc: A slowly rotating pale blue ring at your feet, plus a fading pale blue particle trail as you move. Purely visual, and visible to every player.
screen.kunjinkao.qol.invincible.desc: Whether the full damage immunity granted by an injected item is active. When on, nothing can hurt you while you carry an injected item or the admin sword; turn it off to take damage normally. On by default.
screen.kunjinkao.qol.stand_firm.desc: You cannot be pushed, knocked back, launched, or teleported to another dimension: only your own movement keys (or jump) move you. Falling still works, otherwise you would hang in mid-air. Vehicles and elytra gliding still carry you as usual.
screen.kunjinkao.qol.zone_break.desc: Bind a key to this row; pressing it digs the selection out (drops are computed with your main-hand item). Break and Place each have their own key.
screen.kunjinkao.qol.zone_place.desc: Bind a key to this row; pressing it fills the empty spots with the off-hand block, falling back to your inventory and then to AE storage.
screen.kunjinkao.qol.bind_action_cell: Action key: pressing it runs the job on the current selection
screen.kunjinkao.qol.bind_toggle_cell: Toggle key: pressing it flips this setting
message.kunjinkao.zone_need_stick: §7Right-click blocks with a stick to set the selection corners
message.kunjinkao.zone_adjust_need_corne: §cSet both corners before adjusting the selection
message.kunjinkao.zone_adjust_too_big: §cThat would exceed the %s block side limit
message.kunjinkao.zone_ae_inserted: §7Sent %s drop stacks into the AE network
message.kunjinkao.zone_ae_unavailable: §eNo usable AE network nearby; drops went to your inventory instead
message.kunjinkao.zone_confirm_place: §eThis will fill %sx%sx%s (%s blocks) with the off-hand block. §cPress the place key again to confirm§e; hold Shift and press an action key to cancel
message.kunjinkao.zone_fill_out_of_items: §eOut of material: stopped after %s blocks. No more of that block in the off hand, inventory or AE storage
message.kunjinkao.zone_fill_bad_item: §cThe off-hand item is not a block, so it cannot be used to fill
screen.kunjinkao.qol.night_vision.desc: Permanent night vision with no flicker. Shares one state with the night vision button in the tactical HUD.
screen.kunjinkao.qol.fly_mining.desc: Mining in mid-air and underwater is no longer slowed down; speed matches mining on the ground.
screen.kunjinkao.qol.water_breath.desc: Your air bar stays full underwater. No drowning, no bubble-pop sound.
screen.kunjinkao.qol.village_hero.desc: Permanent Hero of the Village, so villager trades are discounted. Higher level means a bigger discount; the cap is set by the server.
screen.kunjinkao.qol.reach.desc: Adds this many blocks to both block and entity interaction range. Set to 0 to turn it off.
screen.kunjinkao.qol.durability_protecti: Items you use no longer lose durability, including tools, weapons and armour.
screen.kunjinkao.qol.fire_immune.desc: Immune to fire and lava damage, and you never catch fire.
screen.kunjinkao.qol.unlimited_trades.de: Trading with a villager does not consume uses, so trades never sell out. Villager XP and reputation are untouched.
screen.kunjinkao.qol.villager_master.des: After one trade the villager jumps straight to Master and rerolls every high-tier offer. This permanently changes the villager.
screen.kunjinkao.qol.treasure_hunter.des: Draws through-wall highlight boxes on chests, barrels, spawners, suspicious sand and similar containers within the radius.
screen.kunjinkao.qol.fog_vision.desc: Pushes the fog back underwater and in lava so you can see further. May conflict with shaders; turn this off first if the screen looks wrong.
screen.kunjinkao.qol.machine_loot.desc: Drop multiplier for kills made by fake players (simulated-player machines). 1 = vanilla. Only works for machines using the NeoForge fake player.
screen.kunjinkao.qol.xp_boost.desc: While on, grants one experience level every tick (20 levels per second). It no longer affects kill XP; it is a pure self-buff.
screen.kunjinkao.qol.anvil_unbreakable.d: Put two identical items in an anvil to combine them into an Unbreakable result.
screen.kunjinkao.qol.anvil_xp_cost.desc: How many experience levels that combination costs.
screen.kunjinkao.qol.treasure_hunter_ser: Server master switch for Treasure Hunter. When off, nobody can use it and personal toggles stop working.
screen.kunjinkao.qol.treasure_hunter_rad: Scan radius in blocks. Raising it increases the client-side scanning cost.
screen.kunjinkao.qol.zone_excavate_serve: Server master switch for zone work. It changes terrain irreversibly, so it is off by default.
screen.kunjinkao.qol.zone_max_side.desc: Maximum length of one side in blocks. Note the block count grows cubically: doubling a side is eight times the work.
screen.kunjinkao.qol.zone_drop_policy.de: Where the dug-out blocks go: 0 = straight into your inventory, 1 = dropped on the ground, 2 = destroyed, 3 = into the AE network first (anything that does not fit goes to your inventory).
screen.kunjinkao.qol.zone_tick_budget.de: How many milliseconds per tick may be spent digging. Raising it only finishes sooner; it does not change the total.
screen.kunjinkao.qol.zone_batch_side.des: How many blocks are handled per batch. Works together with the tick budget; whichever limit is hit first wins.
screen.kunjinkao.qol.zone_undo_max.desc: How many block snapshots may be recorded for undo. Jobs above this limit tell you up front that they cannot be undone. 0 disables undo entirely.
